name: Tassel the Tufted-Ear Cat
blurb: Tassel, a tawny-gold spotted shorthair with black-tipped ear tufts and a short bobbed tail, chases falling leaves along the garden wall.

name: Sleet the Frost-Grey Cat
blurb: Sleet, a silver-grey cat with faint dark spots, a fluffy cheek ruff and big furry paws, pads across the frosty lawn without a sound.

name: Haybale the Bobtail Cat
blurb: Haybale, a sandy-buff cat with dark-spotted legs, a white belly and a stubby black-tipped tail, naps on top of the garden gate at dusk.
